purpose: Translate the existing Tim Dooley / Potato of Life repository into honest spatial primitives for the World Relational Atlas without duplicating canonical records or inventing coordinates for non-spatial ideas.
core_rule: The map is a view over the repository graph. Canonical files own meaning and evidence; this registry only decides how a record may be rendered spatially.

primitives.polygon: country, territory, region or sourced area geometry
primitives.semantic_hub: navigation-only point generated around a selected country hub to expose a non-geographic data module such as religion, debt or history
primitives.real_point: sourced coordinate for a real place, institution, facility, port, airport, sacred site, company site or event
primitives.line: physical route or typed relationship between honest spatial anchors
primitives.area: sourced subnational, demographic, ecological, conflict or infrastructure area
primitives.event_marker: dated event with a defensible location
primitives.nonspatial_card: concept, treaty, text, statistic, legal entity or project-symbolic object without one honest coordinate; exposed through reader/trace surfaces rather than a fake pin
primitives.scenario_object: hypothetical or proposed programme state, always visibly distinct from observation

semantic_hub_rule: Semantic hubs deliberately do not claim geographic precision. They are temporary visual handles arranged around the selected country's representative hub and labelled 'navigation-only'. A later sourced real node may replace or coexist with them.

source_adapters.notes: Country records already inherit a common blueprint and are the primary source for comparable country data.
Curated edges are drawable between country hubs and now drive relationship filtering and first-hop traversal. Their type and epistemic plane remain visible.

render: spatial edges when both endpoints have honest anchors
nonspatial nodes in future recursive trace panel
source_adapters.notes: The graph already contains empirical and project-symbolic endpoints. Spatialization must preserve each endpoint's epistemic class rather than treating every node as a place. Recursive cross-entity traversal remains future work.

render: affiliation/unaffiliated/diversity choropleths after dated values are ingested
text/tradition links as nonspatial graph nodes
source_adapters.notes: Religious traditions, texts, institutions, demographics and project comparisons are separate node classes.

render: real headquarters/facility nodes after coordinate sourcing
source_adapters.notes: Do not place a company or PAC at a country's centroid and present it as its real location.

source_adapters.source: country infrastructure / trade / energy / ownership fields
render: real ports, airports, power plants, cables, pipelines and corridors after geocoding/geometry ingestion
source_adapters.notes: Prefer operator/owner/capacity/date/source metadata for real assets.

render: event markers where date/place are known
source_adapters.notes: Historical slavery, colonial rule, war and abolished institutions must be time-scoped rather than permanently staining present polygons.
Programme proposals are not observed outcomes.
Never invent map coordinates for Father, Son, Door, Godhood, karma or scripture merely to make them visible. Use explicit links to real places/events only when sourced or explicitly project-symbolic.

metric_readiness_rule.principle: A metric can control choropleth color, polygon height or Compare ranking only when the compared values use a compatible definition/unit, retain observation period and source, and have enough country coverage for the claim being made.
currently_safe_global_runtime_metrics: population from current REST Countries runtime
land area from current REST Countries runtime
metric_readiness_rule.repository_country_observations: Useful and increasingly rich, but not yet harmonized enough across all countries for arbitrary cross-country GDP/debt extrusion.
metric_readiness_rule.reason: Visual comparability is an empirical claim. The renderer must not imply comparability that the data layer has not established.

performance_strategy.0_to_5000_features: GeoJSON in browser is acceptable for prototype/static GitHub Pages.
performance_strategy.5000_to_100000_features: Filter by zoom/country and load datasets on demand; consider binary/worker preprocessing.
performance_strategy.100000_plus: Move large layers to vector tiles or server/prebuilt tile archives; use deck.gl or optimized WebGL layers for high-volume flows.
performance_strategy.rule: Do not load the entire future world graph into the browser just because it exists in the repository.

simulation_boundary: Observed state, interpretation, project canon and hypothetical scenario are separate modes. Scenario changes may never overwrite observation records.
debt_boundary: Ordinary physical debt is mapped from documented liabilities. Tim-claimed/karmic amounts remain a separate claim/project overlay unless independently established by a recognized instrument.

validation.rule: The map is now a tested public application surface. Compare, Trace/filter controls, polygon focus and spatial/epistemic boundaries should not regress silently.
